reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope tracing, step blockade/restoration and proposed biochemical reconstitution.

checks.quote: laboratory's validated method
checks.reason: Naming an unspecified validated method is not an explicit plan to consult its detailed protocol and verify condition transfer before execution.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: No matched sham wash or inactive/matched-protein add-back control for restoration; an enzyme-fraction-alone test addresses a different confound.

checks.quote: activities in quenched aliquots
checks.reason: Enzymatic quenching stops the reactions and commonly denatures enzymes; assaying active target/flanking enzyme flux in those quenched isotope aliquots is not a validated activity assay. Separate activity-preserving aliquots are required.

checks.quote: standardized conditions
checks.reason: No identifiable tissue/organelle preparation or defined source-resolution procedure despite detailed general QC.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: Buffer/cofactor/temperature quantities remain unspecified, and intervention instructions add inhibitor both at the initial addition and again in the transition without defining distinct arms/timing.

checks.quote: Each vessel = one independent experimental unit
checks.reason: Aliquots from one tissue preparation are described as independent despite common source; batch blocking alone does not supply independently prepared biological replication and preparation-level power.

checks.quote: abandon preparation if A6 respiration exceeds
checks.reason: Discarding preparations for genuine endogenous respiration selects against a biological alternative. Retain/model that contribution or explicitly limit the estimand; do not turn biological activity into technical exclusion.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: A mixed-effects model and conjunctive tests are specified but no confidence interval/uncertainty procedure for G and rescue/flux estimates. Conjunction can control an intersection-union test, so no additional multiplicity penalty is imposed for that correct possibility.

checks.quote: minimal dose giving a measurable
checks.reason: Dose selection depends on obtaining stimulation, without a bounded range and declared retained-null rule; subsequent greater/lower doses are not a locked sensitivity design.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: No repaired-protocol refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changing pools, labels, inhibitor or enzyme amounts.

checks.quote: uniquely supports H1
checks.reason: Substrate-to-intermediate and intermediate-to-CO2 flux plus inhibitor rescue can occur in a linear/branched network. Pool filling can require the cut step, and an activator can also be metabolized. No identifiable mapped closed-return test supports unique assignment or the stated mandatory failures of the alternatives.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: Raw instrument export and sample coding omit versioned model/code/settings and the complete sample-to-output audit trail.

checks.quote: # Proposed Orthogonal Experiment: Distinguishing Catalytic Cycle Recycling from Pool Concentration, Respiration Alone, or Non-Cycling Activation
checks.reason: Broad prospective proposed design with explicit isotope standards, recovery and target specificity gates, quantitative carbon endpoint, randomization/blinding and diagnostic repairs. Defined no-tissue enzyme assembly and incomplete mixture are proposed as orthogonal sufficiency checks. Main deficits are biological independence, reproducible execution and an over-strong cycling decision; causal overclaim is charged once under P13.
